description: MCP catalog tools that let an LLM discover placeable wireframe components and fetch exact component schemas. Catalog lookup supports compact responses, category filtering, app scopes, target pack visibility, role metadata, and typo suggestions.

members.name: wireframe_list_components
members.description: Lists available components. Start with compact=true; optionally filter by category, scopeAppId, targetPackIds, skip, and take.

members.name: wireframe_get_component_schema
members.description: Returns the full property contract for a component type, including default size, props, roles, and container metadata. Unknown types return a suggestion when possible.
